title: Sun Hang Do Martial Arts

services.name: Day Camp
services.desc: The After School Athletic Program will pick up your child at their school so they can receive all the benefits that Sun Hang Do has to offer in a safe and positive learning environment. The program runs from school pick up time until 5:00pm, making it convenient to pick up your child after work! Currently available at the Vancouver, Maple Ridge, and Abbotsford locations! Allow your child to receive the benefits of Sun Hang Do training from when their school day ends until your work day does. Our positive and inclusive environment with progressive peers and instructors provides a safe environment for your child to develop. Our After School Athletic Program is the best way to take advantage

blurb: Sun Hang Do was developed from ancient Korean traditions and it has been merged into the martial arts of today’s world. It is the art of perfect balance born from the union of two dynamic opposites, the hardness of steel and the softness of water, one continuously moving and the other suddenly stopping, utilizing the full extent of mind and body working together in harmony.
